sources.title: Nature Sounds Pack
sources.author: Antoine Goumain (Antoinemax)
sources.description: Hi, my name is Antoine. I'm a French Sound Designer. I've created a Sound pack with the theme of nature. Ambient sound (5 sounds) Foliage (6 sounds) Footstep (9 sounds) Stream (3 sounds) Here is my portfolio : https://antoinegoumain.fr/ Here is my LinkedIn : https://www.linkedin.com/in/antoinegoumain/ Here is my Patreon page if you like my work and you want to help me : https://www.patreon.com/antoinegoumain

sources.title: 100 CC0 SFX #2
sources.author: rubberduck
sources.description: another pack with 100 CC0 sfx Note: the preview does not contain all sounds, it also contains loopable sfx which are shorter in the preview. Included are: air flowing, door, various footstep, glass, hit, item, loops (ambient, machine, construction site, highway / street, flowing water), metal / metal hit, misc, stones, switch, thunder and wood / wood hit - sounds
